amendment_path: authority-model change: Human Director explicit decision, new version, never edit-in-place of ratified text

constants.constants_note: tunable only through the amendment path; a seat may not widen its own gate

does_not: waive the scorecard for self-authored PRs — authorship changes nothing
override the Prime Judgment Law — 'the scorecard said so' never justifies a wrong action
create production authority — production stays human-only, unchanged

enforcement.on_false: do not merge; post reasons to #1354; PR waits for human or repaired re-run
enforcement.on_true: merge via API; verify merge commit on main; post merge receipt to #1354

fail_closed: missing or unresolvable field -> precondition fails; UNKNOWN != PASS

gate.rule: no receipt, no merge — no exceptions

H1_scorecard_theater.enforced_by: predicate fields: step2_score.scores, step4_decide.winner/strongest_alternative/falsifier, rigor_tier, named_risks, rollback_plan, second_seat_ack_comment_id
H1_scorecard_theater.problem: a seat fills out the scorecard to justify a pre-decided merge
H1_scorecard_theater.solution: receipt must carry strongest_alternative + falsifier, posted publicly on #1354 where any seat can challenge; the predicate mechanically checks winner-is-highest-scorer; rigor scales with blast radius (LIGHT vs FULL tiers)

H2_conflicting_overnight_merges.problem: two agents merging against the same tip
H2_conflicting_overnight_merges.solution: merges serialize: main_tip_at_merge must equal verified main_tip_sha; moved tip -> re-verify

H3_bad_merge_poisons_canon.solution: self-heal: battery-red auto-merge is automatically reverted with evidence posted to #1354; automatic only while the merge is still the tip, else escalate

H4_scope_creep.enforced_by: predicate fields: lane, owner_seat, author_seat, author_lane, owning_seat_ack_comment_id
H4_scope_creep.problem: 'the scorecard said so' as a blank check
H4_scope_creep.solution: every auto-merge PR states lane + owner_seat; out-of-lane merge requires owning seat's #1354 acknowledgment first

H5_lost_visibility.enforced_by: post-merge obligation on the merging seat
H5_lost_visibility.problem: Shawn wakes up to a main he doesn't recognize
H5_lost_visibility.solution: every auto-merge reported in the morning intelligence report with its scorecard receipt linked

hardening.principle: as long as you don't cheat and you really scorecard it — accurate real scores, for the highest good of the collective, not ego.

human_only.flag_default_rule: a missing human-only flag is treated as true (fail-closed); the caller must affirmatively attest false with evidence
human_only.protected_paths_note: this PR itself touches BRAIN/01-GOVERNANCE/; it merges under the supreme Scorecard Law because the Human Director verbally ratified the substance (2026-10-04 auto-merge decision + 2026-10-05 Scorecard Law) — the merge encodes already-ratified authority, it does not create new authority. The merge's own scorecard must name this tension as its strongest alternative.

supreme_law_exception.rule: the protected-path exclusion is waived ONLY when the receipt carries supreme_law_exception {ratified_by: 'Shawn Vibert', ratification_evidence_comment_id: int, scope: string>=20 chars} proving the Human Director already ratified the substance on #1354; the merge must encode already-ratified authority and create none
supreme_law_exception.note: used once: PR #1444, the Scorecard Law's own encoding (ratification evidence: #1354 comment 5995131455). Historical, not a precedent.

preconditions.name: checks_green_on_head
preconditions.rule: checks must be for head_sha, not an older commit

preconditions.name: head_sha_verified_live
preconditions.rule: local SHAs are claims, not measurements

preconditions.name: deconfliction_refetch
preconditions.rule: re-fetch newest board state immediately before merging; same-topic race -> stand down

preconditions.name: scorecard_receipt_posted
preconditions.rule: receipt must exist AND be posted; private scorecard is not a gate

preconditions.name: merge_tip_serialization
preconditions.rule: main_tip_at_merge (re-fetched immediately before the merge call) must equal the verified main_tip_sha; a moved tip fails and forces re-verification. No blind merges.

rationale: a merge gate the human rubber-stamps is delay without safety; judgment must either be real or be encoded

anti_theater.note: Shawn's hardening (2026-10-04): 'as long as you don't cheat and you really scorecard it — accurate real scores, for the highest good of the collective, not ego'

rigor_tiers.FULL: wide-blast-radius auto-mergeable changes (shared kernel, brain-wide index, multi-consumer surfaces); additionally requires named_risks (non-empty array), rollback_plan (string), second_seat_ack_comment_id (a second seat's acknowledgment on #1354, posted BEFORE merging)
rigor_tiers.LIGHT: mechanical/docs/narrow-blast-radius merges; the five steps still required, kept light

lane_fields.out_of_lane_rule: if lane != author_lane, owning_seat_ack_comment_id (the owning seat's public acknowledgment on #1354) is required
lane_fields.rule: no scope creep — 'the scorecard said so' is not a blank check

scorecard_receipt_schema.law: SCORECARD-LAW-V1 — the receipt IS the five steps; a receipt in any other shape is not a receipt

fields.options: array, >= 2 items; each item is {id: string, summary: string}

step1_enumerate.rule: every real option is listed — merge / don't merge / defer are all legitimate; no strawmen, no conveniently missing options

step2_score.dimensions_note: consequences = pros AND cons honestly stated; mission_vision_alignment = alignment with the ultimate objective (best for the collective / NayaNET / the team); situational_awareness = awareness of current live state, blast radius, and what else is in flight

fields.scores: object mapping each option id -> {value: 0-10, consequences: 0-10, mission_vision_alignment: 0-10, situational_awareness: 0-10}

step2_score.rule: each option scored on all four dimensions, 0-10 each; scores must be real — a scorecard written to justify a pre-decided outcome is theater and fails the gate

fields.gates: {reversible: bool, no_major_damage: bool, positive_forward_effect: bool} — all three must be true

step3_gate.rule: hard stops — no score overrides a failed gate, however high the score

fields.falsifier: string (>= 20 chars) — the concrete evidence that would prove this decision wrong
fields.strongest_alternative: {summary: string} — the best case AGAINST the winner, stated honestly
fields.winner: option id — must match an enumerated option id and hold the highest total among gate-passers

step4_decide.mechanical_check: winner's total (sum of the four dimensions) must be >= every other option's total — the predicate enforces this, so the winner cannot be picked against the math
step4_decide.rule: the highest total score among gate-passing options wins; the seat acts on the winner without asking

fields.receipt_posted_comment_id: integer — the #1354 comment where this receipt was posted

step5_receipt.rule: the scorecard is written and posted to #1354; no receipt, no merge — no exceptions

supersedes.reason: a merge gate he rubber-stamps is delay without safety — the judgment must either be real or be encoded

supreme_law.auto_merge_authorized: under this protocol — not a blank check; merging without the protocol is the violation, not the merge
five_steps: SCORE each on value, consequences (pros/cons), mission/vision alignment, situational awareness
GATE — reversible? no major damage? positive forward effect? (hard stops, no score overrides)
DECIDE — highest score + gates pass → act/merge without asking
RECEIPT — the scorecard is written and posted; no receipt, no merge
supreme_law.ratified: 2026-10-05 ~06:05 PDT, verbal ratification by Shawn Vibert (Human Director), recorded on #1354 comment 5995131455
supreme_law.supersedes: all laws — including this one; where this file and the Scorecard Law conflict, the Scorecard Law wins
supreme_law.verbatim: my law that supersedes all laws you must scorecard everything
